from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper from the collection and its outgoing citations to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being analyzed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers found in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
